C x.ss-state-limitations EX WF-020,WF-009 MUST ;; State in the report that a static review cannot prove the application secure and may miss runtime, infrastructure, business-logic and dynamic-exploitation issues. ;; = ;; none ;; Limitation statement not in the oracle.
C wf020.ss-concrete OL WF-020,WF-012 MUST ;; Report concrete security risks, not generic security advice. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-context OL WF-020 MUST ;; Evaluate findings in the context of actual exposure and application behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-distinguish OL WF-020 MUST ;; Distinguish confirmed findings from items that need verification. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.ss-no-unneeded-mechanisms OL GOV-013,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not require security mechanisms the project does not need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.ss-use-rules OL WF-001 MUST ;; Use the project's security, authentication, configuration, logging, error-handling, HTTP and resilience rules and skills during the scan. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf021.ss-tool-independence OL WF-021 MUST_NOT ;; Do not require a specific MCP server, agent, analyzer, commercial scanner or external tool; tooling is evidence, not the sole authority. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-owasp-taxonomy EX WF-020 DEFAULT ;; Use OWASP Top 10:2025 as an awareness taxonomy when it genuinely fits; not every issue needs a category; do not force an inaccurate mapping. ;; = ;; none ;; Taxonomy usage rule not in the oracle.
C wf007.ss-scope-surfaces OL WF-007,WF-009 MUST ;; Before scanning determine which surfaces exist; skip irrelevant checks rather than reporting them as failures. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.ss-select-scope OL WF-007 MUST ;; Full pre-release or requested audits review all applicable layers; targeted changes start with affected layers and expand when the change crosses security boundaries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf021.ss-scanner-findings OL WF-021,WF-020 MUST ;; Use available search/compiler/audit/analyzer tooling; for a scanner-reported issue inspect the code, determine reachability and relevance, and report only with appropriate confidence. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-severity-scale EX WF-020 DEFINITION ;; Severity scale: Critical (sparingly, immediately exploitable high impact), High, Medium, Low, Info (hardening observation, not a demonstrated vulnerability). ;; = ;; none ;; Five-level scale definition not in the oracle.
C sec001.ss-not-safe OL SEC-001,SEC-010,SEC-005,SEC-009,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not automatically treat as safe: secrets in Development settings, sensitive values logged only at Debug, client route guards, hidden buttons, CORS used as authorization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-finding-fields EX WF-020 MUST ;; Every confirmed finding includes severity, file/location, title, evidence, why it is a risk, likely impact, smallest reasonable remediation and the OWASP category when applicable. ;; = ;; none ;; Mandatory finding fields not in the oracle.
C x.ss-report-template EX WF-020,WF-009 DEFAULT ;; Security report shape: Scope, Limitations, severity Summary counts, Findings, Layer Results table. ;; = ;; none ;; Report template not in the oracle.
C x.ss-layer-status EX WF-009 MUST ;; Layer results use PASS, FINDINGS, NOT APPLICABLE or NOT CHECKED. ;; = ;; none ;; Status vocabulary differs from WF-009's PASS/NOT RUN/NOT APPLICABLE.
C wf009.ss-no-unchecked-pass OL WF-009 MUST_NOT ;; Never mark an uninspected layer as passed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.ss-remediation OL GOV-013,GOV-014,SEC-006,SEC-008 MUST_NOT ;; Prefer the smallest secure change; do not recommend unnecessary new authentication systems, custom cryptography, blanket field encryption, [Authorize] on every action under a global policy, security libraries merely to satisfy the scan, or disabling functionality a scanner cannot understand. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-completion OL WF-020,WF-009 MUST ;; A scan is complete when applicable layers were inspected, findings have evidence, uncertain findings are labelled, severity reflects actual risk and no layer is PASS unchecked. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.sw-config-layer EX ARC-012 DEFAULT ;; Keep Swagger configuration in the API/composition layer. ;; = ;; none ;; Placement rule not in the oracle.
C dep003.sw-version OL DEP-003 MUST ;; Select the Swagger package version through add-dependency. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-launch-profile EX DEP-012 DEFAULT ;; For a new local Development API configure the launch profile to open Swagger directly when that helps. ;; = ;; When that helps. ;; Launch configuration not in the oracle.
C x.sw-launch-urls EX WF-006 MUST ;; Application URLs agree with the launch profile; do not point a browser launch URL at HTTPS on an HTTP-only port. ;; = ;; none ;; Launch consistency rule not in the oracle.
C api016.sw-full-pipeline OL API-016 MUST ;; Determine documented responses from the complete HTTP pipeline (binding, validation, auth, rate limiting, exception handling, middleware); do not document 201 for 200 or 204 for a body. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.sw-201 OL API-016,API-003 MUST ;; Document 201 Created only when it is the runtime contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.sw-error-contracts OL API-016,API-002 DEFAULT ;; Describe ProblemDetails/ValidationProblemDetails failure contracts where useful. ;; = ;; Where useful. ;;
C api008.sw-no-internal OL API-008 MUST_NOT ;; Swagger examples and descriptions never show internal exception types, stack traces, SQL, connection strings or filesystem paths. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.sw-auth-metadata OL API-016 MUST ;; Configure security definitions only when the API actually uses authentication; do not add a scheme merely because a package is installed or apply auth requirements globally to anonymous endpoints. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-bearer-ui EX DEP-012 DEFAULT ;; For Bearer authentication expose a Bearer scheme so authenticated endpoints can be exercised through Swagger UI. ;; = ;; Bearer authentication used. ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.sw-descriptions EX API-016 DEFAULT ;; Document consumer-relevant preconditions, idempotency, pagination/filtering and outcomes rather than repeating action/property names. ;; = ;; none ;; Documentation-content guidance not in the oracle.
C x.sw-xml-docs EX API-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add XML comments to every internal type solely for Swagger generation. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.sw-multiple-docs EX API-016,API-015 MUST_NOT ;; Use multiple Swagger documents only for a real contract separation (versions, public/internal surfaces). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api014.sw-client-contracts OL API-014,API-016,WF-016 MUST ;; When the contract feeds client generation treat breaking schema changes seriously, keep response metadata accurate and review generated-client changes when the contract changes. ;; = ;; Contract feeds client generation. ;;
C x.sw-explicit-contracts EX API-016,API-014 AVOID ;; Avoid unstable anonymous response shapes / anonymous objects as long-lived API contracts; use explicit request/response contracts. ;; = ;; none ;; Explicit-contract rule not in the oracle.
C wf006.sw-verify OL WF-006,WF-005,API-016 MUST ;; When API behaviour changes verify Controller behaviour/integration tests and response metadata; start the API when startup/composition changed and confirm the Development Swagger UI loads; exercise endpoints through Swagger when meaningful. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.sw-preserve OL TST-010 MUST ;; Preserve newly verified behaviour as maintained tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-not-test-substitute EX TST-002 MUST_NOT ;; Swagger must not be used as a substitute for integration tests. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in api.md or the oracle.
C gov013.sw-second-stack OL GOV-013,DEP-012 MUST_NOT ;; No second competing API documentation stack without a concrete need. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.tm-read-map EX - MUST ;; Read .claude/MAP.md first when maintaining the instruction system. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta procedure.
C x.tm-trigger-role EX - MUST ;; Keep each policy's trigger role: planning-time policy on the always-loaded surface, path policy in a path rule covering its full scope, procedural obligations in their workflow. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-placement invariant (repo/meta).
C x.tm-no-hidden-must EX - MUST_NOT ;; Do not hide a must/must-not rule only inside a knowledge skill or a private reference. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-placement invariant (repo/meta).
C x.tm-slot-names EX - MUST ;; Outside a capability implementation refer to slot names and facet roles, not the selected implementation's name. ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-system rule (repo/meta).
C x.tm-compact-surface EX - MUST_NOT ;; Keep the always-loaded surface (CLAUDE.md, imports, skill descriptions) compact; do not load the whole corpus to solve reliability. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta rule.
C x.tm-update-map EX - MUST ;; Update .claude/MAP.md after changing instruction artifacts. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta rule.
C x.tm-run-checker EX - MUST ;; Run check-instructions.js after instruction-system changes and fix every error. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta rule.
C x.tm-replacement-steps EX ARC-020,DEP-002 MUST ;; Capability replacement procedure: read CONTRACT.md and current MODULE.md, create a complete new manifest, rewrite every facet at its role-named location with updated Capability headers, update the selection row and remove the old directory, review binds and frame layer names, run the checker and update the map. ;; = ;; After an approved ADR. ;; Repo/meta procedure.
C x.tm-provider-adr EX DEP-009,GOV-017 MUST ;; Record an ADR for a persistence provider-variant change. ;; = ;; none ;; Recording obligation not in the oracle.
C x.tm-frontend-removal EX - MUST ;; Removing the optional frontend slot: set the row to disabled with implementation '—', delete listed facet files and the module directory, remove the frontend planning import, update the map, run the checker; other instructions need no edits. ;; = ;; Frontend slot removal. ;; Repo/meta procedure.

42 NN ;; Heading.
44-49 MX [wf005.v-tests,x.v-test-scope] ;; Running relevant tests and investigating every new failure is WF-005; complete-suite vs affected-first scope and inspecting package.json rather than assuming a runner are added.

134-138 OL [run010.v-usings]

C wf007.v-configured-tooling OL WF-007,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not require optional tooling the repository has not configured. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.v-inspect OL WF-004,GOV-014 MUST ;; Review the final changed-file set and diff before choosing checks: scope match, no unrelated refactoring, no accidental generated/build artifacts, no secrets or environment-specific credentials. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.v-probes-before-removal OL TST-010 MUST ;; Remove temporary diagnostics and probes only after behaviour they uniquely verified is preserved as maintained automated coverage. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.v-affected-areas OL WF-004,WF-007 MUST ;; Determine affected repository areas (backend, frontend, both, documentation-only without unrelated builds). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.v-build OL WF-005 MUST ;; Build the affected solution or projects; a build failure means the implementation is not complete. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.v-no-restore EX WF-005 MUST_NOT ;; Do not use --no-restore unless restore is known to be complete. ;; = ;; Restore known complete. ;; Build-command restriction not in the oracle.
C wf005.v-tests OL WF-005 MUST ;; Run tests covering the changed area; investigate every newly failing relevant test; do not dismiss a failure as unrelated without checking. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.v-test-scope EX WF-005,TST-002 DEFAULT ;; Small solutions run the complete suite; large ones run affected test projects first then any broader suite the risk requires; inspect package.json rather than assuming a frontend test runner. ;; = ;; none ;; Test-run scope rule not in the oracle.
C wf006.v-smoke OL WF-006 MUST ;; For new runnable applications or substantial startup/composition/configuration/persistence/full-stack changes verify Development startup and key composition surfaces; a build alone does not prove runtime composition. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.v-preserve OL TST-010 MUST ;; Preserve behaviour uniquely demonstrated by an ad-hoc/manual probe in maintained automated coverage before completion unless equivalent coverage exists (verify it); builds/static analysis/formatting/existing suites need no new tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.v-risk-scoped OL WF-007 MUST ;; Run architecture, formatting, dependency/security and delivery checks when the change makes them relevant, not indiscriminately. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.v-architecture-check OL WF-007,ARC-001,WF-001 MUST ;; When the change touches architectural boundaries verify architecture.md rules (reading it if not loaded) and run the deterministic check-architecture.js check. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst008.v-seed-check OL PST-008 MUST ;; When a model/persistence change affects seeded entities confirm persistence-change § Seed Data was applied. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.v-skip-docs OL WF-007 MUST_NOT ;; Skip the architecture audit for documentation-only or unrelated changes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.v-format OL WF-007,GOV-013,WF-021 MUST ;; Run configured formatting/analyzers; do not add a formatter or analyzer dependency solely to complete verification; analyzer output still requires context. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.v-dependency-security OL WF-007,DEP-004,WF-011 MUST ;; For dependency changes run check-manifests.js and add-dependency's vulnerability commands; for security-sensitive work inspect secrets, authorization, SQL safety, CORS/TLS, sensitive logging and certificate validation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf017.v-ci-source OL WF-017 MUST ;; CI definitions stay in source control, reproduce supported build/test commands and must not hide failures. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf018.v-npm OL WF-018 MUST ;; Frontend CI uses scripts that exist in package.json and npm ci when a maintained lockfile supports it; do not invent scripts or reflexively replace the lockfile install. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf019.v-prod-migrations OL WF-019 MUST_NOT ;; Production migrations are not applied automatically from normal startup by default; they are explicit deployment operations with approved credentials; Development seeding never runs in Production. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.v-final-diff OL WF-004,TST-010,ARC-001 MUST ;; Review the final diff after all fixes for accidental unrelated edits, architecture drift and behaviour verified manually but never preserved as a test. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.v-diff-hygiene EX WF-004 MUST ;; Final diff contains no commented-out code, temporary logging, unintended TODO/FIXME markers or stale temporary tests/scripts. ;; = ;; none ;; Diff-hygiene items not in the oracle.
C gov003.v-spec-drift OL GOV-003,GOV-021 MUST ;; Final diff has no unapproved drift from SPECIFICATION.md or CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md and no stale code/tests/docs/configuration after a CUSTOM_SETTINGS change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run010.v-usings OL RUN-010 MUST ;; Remove unused/redundant usings in every created or modified C# file (incl. those covered by implicit/global usings unless needed for clarity); verify rather than assume; no repository-wide cleanup. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.v-instruction-check EX - MUST ;; When instruction files changed run check-instructions.js during verification. ;; = ;; Instruction files changed. ;; Repo/meta check.
C wf008.v-fix-retry OL WF-008,WF-013,WF-014 MUST ;; On failure identify the concrete failure, make the smallest fix (build-fix for build/test failures), rerun affected verification and builds/tests when code changed, repeat until green or user input is required. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf008.v-no-hide OL WF-008,WF-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not hide a known failure and declare completion. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf009.v-report OL WF-009 MUST ;; Report what was actually run with PASS / NOT RUN / NOT APPLICABLE; never imply an unchecked area passed. ;; = ;; none ;;
